subject: New vendor connection: banking credentials, PO routing, and remittance sample
messages:
From: Ben Cho <ben.cho@clearlinecorp.com>

Cc: AP Team <ap@clearlinecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: New vendor — Redwood Inference: banking / PO info

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist. Attached are the W-9 and a redacted recent bank statement that shows the account name and routing number (clearline_bank_statement_redacted.pdf, clearline_w9.pdf). Our AP team is looped here so they can confirm any additional forms.

A few quick details to help with PO mapping and remittance:
- Legal name: Clearline Corporation (doing business as Clearline)
- Preferred remit reference: INV-{PO}-{INVOICE#} (we can adjust if you have a different requirement)
- PO prefix: CLN- (we generally send PO numbers that start CLN-)

Banking (for ACH credits):
- Bank: Third Harbor Bank
- Account name: Clearline Corporation
- Routing (ACH): 071000013
- Account: 2345678901

We can also accept wires; if you need wiring field values I can send that in a follow-up.

We attached the remittance mapping CSV template you requested; when you confirm the PO field we will validate with our finance system.

Let me know when you want me to confirm micro-deposits for verification or if your team prefers another verification flow.

Thanks,
Ben Cho
Director, Finance Operations
Clearline Corporation
Attachments: clearline_w9.pdf, clearline_bank_statement_redacted.pdf
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Cho <ben.cho@clearlinecorp.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 09:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: New vendor — Redwood Inference: banking / PO info

Hi Ben — thanks, received the W-9 and the redacted statement. Looping Jordan (Vendor Ops) and Marissa (PayOps) to run the account through our onboarding checks.

Plan from our side:
1) PayOps will send two micro-deposits to the account you provided for verification (expected within 1 business day). Please confirm when those hit and reply with amounts.
2) Once verified we will set the payment method to ACH and schedule the first settlement run (we typically have a T+5 payment cadence for new suppliers).
3) For PO mapping, we support the INV-{PO}-{INVOICE#} pattern — that will map cleanly. Can you confirm that PO values will always include the CLN- prefix? If not, tell us the alternate format so we can include conditional routing rules.

A few required fields for our finance system (attached is our PO mapping template — po-mapping-template.csv):
- remittance_email: payments@clearlinecorp.com (if different, update)
- vendor_tax_id: please confirm the EIN on the W-9
- currency: USD

Jordan/Marissa — please initiate micro-deposits and add a Vendor Portal case so we have an audit trail. Tag the case to DL-8843.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Manager, Procurement
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

Hi Priya / Jordan / Marissa —

Confirmed — our systems show two small inbound micro-deposits today from Redwood Inference: $0.12 and $0.35. Please verify these amounts with your side and reply when complete.

Quick answers to your questions:
- EIN on W-9: 12-3456789 (matches the document we uploaded).
- remittance_email: ap@clearlinecorp.com (primary) / payments@clearlinecorp.com (backup).
- CLN- prefix: Yes — all our POs will start with CLN- followed by 6 digits (e.g., CLN-102345).

Attached is a sample remittance CSV snippet (inline below) we will emit when a payment is processed — feel free to confirm this maps to your template.

--- remittance_example.csv (preview) ---

CLN-102345,PO-889321,INV-889321,12500.00,2027-12-08
CLN-102346,PO-889322,INV-889322,4300.00,2027-12-08
--- end preview ---

If you need a different column header order or an additional field (e.g., tax breakdown), tell us and we'll include it.

Thanks,
Ben

Ben — thanks, confirmed the micro-deposits ($0.12 and $0.35) and validated the account details. We have the vendor profile created and the PO mapping applied (inv->remit_reference mapping set to INV-{PO}-{INVOICE#}, PO prefix CLN-).

Next steps and notes:
- First payment: scheduled for 2027-12-08 (ACH) under payment run PR-20271208-01; you'll see the remittance file in the AP portal and also via the remittance_email ap@clearlinecorp.com.
- Please include the invoice number in the invoice PDF filename and in the remittance_reference field to avoid reconciliation delays.
- We attached our internal onboarding ticket ID for your reference: Vendor Portal case VP-10972.

Attachments (for your records): onboarding-stub.txt (notes), po-mapping-template.csv (filled by our onboarding team).

If anything changes on your side (wire routing, currency, or tax details) notify us before 2027-12-06 to avoid rescheduling.

Thanks for the fast turnaround — welcome to Redwood.

Best regards,
Priya Natarajan
